ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm GPO/Scheduled-Task fan-out of a destructive payload (CaddyWiper / Prestige / NotPetya pattern)
ucs.description: Hunts Sandworm's signature distribution chain — after compromising a domain controller, the actor (Voodoo Bear / Seashell Blizzard / GRU Unit 74455) pushes a wiper or Prestige-class ransomware to many endpoints simultaneously via a Group Policy logon/startup script or a GPO-deployed scheduled task. Surfaces novel binaries dropped into transient paths (PerfLogs, Windows\Temp, ProgramData, Users\Public, Intel) that are then spawned by gpscript.exe / taskhostw.exe / taskeng.exe across N+ distinct hosts within hours — the exact pattern Mandiant and Microsoft (Seashell Blizzard) attributed to the A
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*\\sysvol\\*" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Policies\\Machine\\Scripts\\*") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Intel\\*") AND NOT (Processes.process_name IN ("wuauclt.exe","mpcmdrun.exe","gpupdate.exe","conhost.exe","msiexec.exe")) by host Processes.process_name Processes.process_hash Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats dc(host) as host_count by process_name process_hash | where host_count >= 3 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WiperWindow = 2h;
let HostThreshold = 3;   // 3+ hosts in <2h running the same novel binary from a GPO/Sched-task parent = Sandworm fan-out
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(WiperWindow)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe")
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\sysvol\", @"\Policies\Machine\Scripts\")
| where FileName !in~ ("wuauclt.exe","mpcmdrun.exe","gpupdate.exe","conhost.exe","msiexec.exe","WerFault.exe")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\PerfLogs\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\", @"\Intel\", @"\Windows\Tasks\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| summarize Hosts = dcount(DeviceName),
            HostList = make_set(DeviceName, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            CmdSample = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            ParentCmdSample = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            Folders = make_set(FolderPath, 5)
            by FileName, SHA256
| where Hosts >= HostThreshold
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WiperWindow = 2h;
let HostThreshold = 3;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(WiperWindow)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("gpscript.exe","taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe")
| where BinName !in ("wuauclt.exe","mpcmdrun.exe","gpupdate.exe","conhost.exe","msiexec.exe","werfault.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\PerfLogs\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Intel\", @"\Windows\Tasks\")
| summarize Hosts = dcount(Computer),
            HostList = make_set(Computer, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            CmdSample = any(CommandLine),
            ParentCmdSample = any(ParentProcessName)
            by BinName, NewProcessName
| where Hosts >= HostThreshold
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\taskhostw.exe OR *\\TaskHostw.exe OR *\\TASKHOSTW.EXE OR *\\taskeng.exe OR *\\TaskEng.exe OR *\\TASKENG.EXE) @Image:(*\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\windows\\temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Intel\\*) -@Image:(*\\wuauclt.exe OR *\\WUAUCLT.EXE OR *\\MpCmdRun.exe OR *\\mpcmdrun.exe OR *\\gpupdate.exe OR *\\GPUpdate.exe OR *\\conhost.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(gpscript|taskhostw|taskeng)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(PerfLogs|Windows\\\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Intel)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(wuauclt|mpcmdrun|gpupdate|conhost|msiexec|werfault)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, ImageFileName], function=[count(aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, ParentImageFileName])])
| HostCount >= 3
| sort(HostCount, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Generic 'binary in Windows\Temp' or 'gpscript spawns process' alone are noisy — Sandworm's distinguishing signature is the *combination* of (a) GPO/scheduled-task delivery context, (b) transient/non-standard staging path, and (c) rapid fan-out to multiple hosts from the same DC compromise. Mandiant's M-Trends and CISA AA22-110A specifically called out CaddyWiper, ArguePatch, Industroyer2 and Prest

ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm pre-wipe recovery-inhibition cascade (vssadmin + wbadmin + bcdedit + wevtutil + fsutil)
ucs.description: Hunts the multi-primitive 'scorched-earth' preparation sequence Sandworm executes seconds-to-minutes before detonating a wiper or Prestige-class ransomware. NotPetya, Olympic Destroyer, HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, and Prestige (all attributed to GRU Unit 74455 / Iron Viking / Seashell Blizzard) all chain shadow-copy deletion, backup-catalog wipe, boot-loader tampering, event-log clearing and USN journal deletion on the same host in the same short window — the inhibit-recovery footprint is the actor's most reliable pre-impact tell.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as bins values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*Delete Shadows*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*" OR Processes.process="*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe AND Processes.process="*cl *") OR (Processes.process_name=fsutil.exe AND Processes.process="*usn deletejournal*") OR (Processes.process_name=schtasks.exe AND Processes.process="*ShadowCopy*")) by host Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval distinct_bins = mvcount(mvdedup(bins)) | where distinct_bins >= 3 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let CascadeWindow = 30m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","Delete Shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
     or (FileName =~ "fsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "usn deletejournal")
     or (FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/Delete","ShadowCopy"))
| summarize
    DistinctPrimitives = dcount(FileName),
    Primitives = make_set(FileName, 10),
    Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
    ParentCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, CascadeWindow)
| where DistinctPrimitives >= 3   // 3+ distinct inhibit-recovery primitives in a 30m window = wiper pre-flight
| extend ElapsedSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CascadeWindow = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where (Bin == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","Delete Shadows"))
     or (Bin == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (Bin == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"))
     or (Bin == "wevtutil.exe" and CommandLine has "cl ")
     or (Bin == "fsutil.exe" and CommandLine has "usn deletejournal")
     or (Bin == "schtasks.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("/Delete","ShadowCopy"))
| summarize
    DistinctPrimitives = dcount(Bin),
    Primitives = make_set(Bin, 10),
    Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
    Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, CascadeWindow)
| where DistinctPrimitives >= 3
| extend ElapsedSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *RecoveryEnabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy* OR *BootStatusPolicy* OR *ignoreallfailures*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"cl "* OR *"clear-log"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\fsutil.exe OR *\\FSUtil.exe OR *\\FSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"usn deletejournal"*) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy|ignoreallfailures)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\s/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\fsutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/usn\s+deletejournal/i)
  )
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctPrimitives), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| DistinctPrimitives >= 3
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Any single primitive (vssadmin delete shadows, bcdedit /set ignoreallfailures, wevtutil cl) appears in legit admin / backup workflows and as standalone ransomware behavior. What makes this a Sandworm-specific signal is the *combination of ≥3 distinct primitives in the same 30-minute window on the same host* — Mandiant's NotPetya analysis, CERT-UA's HermeticWiper / CaddyWiper IR reports, and Micros
